acceptance_criteria.statement: AC1 Domain validation preserves environment-scoped unit identity and policy fields.
AC2 Persistence round-trips explicit units and unit-scoped placement columns.
AC3 Implicit default unit behavior remains backward compatible.

rollout_gates.gate: No existing single-unit environment loses implicit default behavior.
deployment_units writes validate runtime_type, reconcile_mode, and ownership_mode before rollout.

rollback_criteria.criterion: Disable explicit unit creation and continue resolving implicit default units.
Revert deployment-unit migrations only before dependent desired-state/unit data is written.
